about.title: Serving the Community with Compassion
about.subtitle: ALALAY is the digital transformation initiative of the Local Government Unit of General Mamerto Natividad to modernize and streamline the AICS program.
about.who_we_serve_desc: We serve the residents of General Mamerto Natividad, with priority given to indigent families, senior citizens, persons with disabilities, and individuals facing crisis situations.
about.mission_desc: To provide timely, efficient, and compassionate assistance to individuals and families in crisis through a transparent and streamlined digital process.
about.vision_desc: A community where no individual in crisis is left behind, empowered by a responsive and technology-driven social welfare system.
programs.title: Types of Assistance Available
programs.subtitle: The AICS program offers a range of assistance to address various needs of individuals and families in crisis situations.
programs.medical_desc: Financial support for hospitalization, medicines, laboratory tests, and other medical expenses for individuals in crisis.
programs.burial_desc: Financial assistance for funeral and burial expenses of indigent families who have lost a loved one.
programs.educational_desc: Support for educational expenses including school supplies, uniforms, and other learning materials for students.
how_it_works.title: Simple Steps to Get Assistance
how_it_works.step1_desc: Verify if you meet the criteria for your chosen assistance program.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Prepare and submit the required documents through our online portal.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Your application will be reviewed by the MSWDO office for evaluation.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Receive SMS updates on your application status in real-time.
how_it_works.step5_desc: Once approved, claim your assistance at the Municipal Hall.
faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.a1: AICS stands for Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation, a program of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) that provides integrated services to individuals and families experiencing crisis situations.
faqs.a2: Residents of General Mamerto Natividad, Nueva Ecija who are in crisis situation may apply. Priority is given to indigent families, persons with disabilities, senior citizens, and other vulnerable sectors.
faqs.q3: What documents do I need to submit?
faqs.a3: Required documents vary depending on the type of assistance. Common requirements include a valid ID, barangay certificate of indigency, medical certificate (for medical assistance), and death certificate (for burial assistance).
faqs.q4: How long does the application process take?
faqs.a4: The processing time varies depending on the type of assistance and completeness of requirements. Generally, applications are processed within 3-5 working days after submission of complete requirements.
faqs.q5: How do I track my application?
faqs.a5: You can track your application using the reference code provided upon submission. Visit the Track page on our website and enter your reference code to see the real-time status of your application.
faqs.q6: Can I apply for multiple types of assistance?
faqs.a6: Yes, you may apply for different types of assistance. However, each application is evaluated independently based on the specific criteria and available funds for each program.
